stock.description: SOCAM Development Limited functions as an investment holding company, primarily focusing on real estate development and building construction across Hong Kong, Macau, and Mainland China. Its activities are organized into three main divisions: Property, Construction and Building Maintenance, and a range of Other Businesses. The company's construction segment handles diverse projects, including public housing, commercial structures, and institutional buildings. Beyond new construction, it provides services such as interior fitting-out, renovation, ongoing maintenance, and complete facility management. Furthermore, SOCAM is involved in venture capital investments, offers design and contracting solutions, delivers management and consultancy services, and specializes in structural steel fabrication. The company's operations also extend to owning and leasing heavy equipment, supplying building facades, and developing properties for rental. Founded in 1997 as Shui On Construction and Materials Limited, the firm adopted its current name, SOCAM Development Limited, in September 2011. It is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong, and operates as a subsidiary of Shui On Land Limited.
